subject: Future Burnout??
author: ZombieTron
body:
EA have announced a Burnout 6... however there are no details about this at all and Criterion Games are working on NFS:HP and have not said anything to confirm they will be making another Burnout game.

If another Burnout game is going to be made, rest assured we will have all the details here at BurnoutAholics.com!
